items.reason: Describes the same raw_html cooking bypass that stores and renders imported HTML without sanitization, allowing stored XSS.
Describes the same unguarded i.content.scrub call that crashes on description-only feed items and aborts the remaining import.
Describes the same full synchronous feed poll repeated for every uncached article because throttling is per URL. The additional timeout concern does not change the shared problem.
Flags the template's malformed conditional terminator, end if. No golden issue describes this template control-flow problem.
Describes the same incorrect rewriting of protocol-relative links and images onto the article's host.
Describes the same protocol-relative URL corruption caused by stripping leading slashes and prefixing the article host.
Identifies the stale spec expecting a direct TopicRetriever call while the controller enqueues retrieve_topic. This is separate from the golden issue about the missing-embed_url test.
Describes the same unescaped URL interpolation into the imported footer anchor, allowing markup injection into raw HTML.
Flags incorrect escaping of request.referer inside a JavaScript string in the embed layout. This is distinct from the golden postMessage origin-validation issue.
Describes the same URL and username prerequisite tests that pass without exercising their guards because feed polling remains disabled.
Describes the same missing-embed_url test rejected by the host guard before reaching the required-parameter check.
Describes the same nil content crash at i.content.scrub that aborts feed polling.
Describes the same non-atomic embed lookup and creation that raises an unhandled uniqueness exception during concurrent imports. The side-effect discussion adds detail to that race.
